title: Format with %
prompt: Return "NAME has N hp" using a format string instead of joining pieces: "%s has %d hp" % [name, hp].
signature: func solve(name: String, hp: int) -> String:
starter:
func solve(name: String, hp: int) -> String:
	return name
hint: %s is a slot for text and %d a slot for a whole number. The values come after the % in an array, in order.
solution:
func solve(name: String, hp: int) -> String:
	return "%s has %d hp" % [name, hp]
